intro: Command attention with the Mod Knight table—sleek, stylish, and strong. Its contemporary glass top and refined frame make it a statement piece, perfect for creating unforgettable dining experiences​.

features.title: Durable glass for everyday use
features.text: We built this to handle everyday life. The 10 mm thick tempered glass top provides the durability and safety you need for daily use—without compromising on style.

features.title: Strong base with a modern look
features.text: We believe your furniture should work as hard as you do. The black powder-coated metal base resists corrosion while offering dependable stability.

features.title: Sophisticated design that shines
features.text: Clean lines, polished design—this piece enhances your modern interior with effortless sophistication.

features.title: Spacious and comfortable
features.text: Gather around comfortably—this table offers generous space for six, perfect for shared meals and stories.

features.title: Stylish silver legs for support
features.text: Four stylish silver-finished columns form the base, adding structural strength and eye-catching appeal to your dining space.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
